title: alchemilla hoppeana var. glacialis
intro: Alchemilla hoppeana var. glacialis, commonly known as a type of alpine lady's mantle or glacier lady's mantle, is a rare alpine plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include soothing and calming effects on the digestive system, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla hoppeana var. glacialis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties, which contribute to its use in treating skin conditions, gastrointestinal issues, and menstrual disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may have antioxidant and antimicrobial effects.
